_comment: Real content as of 2026-08-13 — see Engineering-Log.md. puzzleClue is intentionally identical across units (same physical switch mechanic on every build). puzzleLinkUrl is intentionally BLANK per unit — each groomsman gets a different destination, and only Skyler knows them. To fill one in: paste the URL between the quotes on that unit's puzzleLinkUrl line below, save, redeploy (see README.md). 'serial' must match that unit's firmware Personalization::SERIAL_NUMBER (config.h) exactly, since it's what's physically printed/shown on the device itself — GM-00N stays as the internal URL routing key only (?unit=...), it is never shown on screen. Units 002/003 need their real serial filled in once chosen/flashed.

GM-001.name: JAKE
objectives: Report for duty on 10.20.2028 — full mission briefing at check-in.
Deliver the best man speech. Keep it under control; keep it real.
Stand beside Skyler at the altar. This is the actual mission.
GM-001.landingQuestion: WILL YOU BE MY BEST MAN?
GM-001.hiddenMessage: SERVICE LOG — This unit was custom-built by Skyler for one reason: you've always shown up when it counted. Every objective on this screen is real. — Thanks for saying yes to standing up there with me. — Skyler
GM-001.puzzleClue:
◈ INTERCEPT — SRC UNKNOWN — 74% RECOVERED ◈

"three sit in a row, but only two are real. the middle stays silent — it has nothing to reveal. right must speak first, and prove itself alone, then left may follow — only then is the code known."

◈ SIGNAL LOST ◈
